Trapped Inside a Capsized Ship. Then Someone Knocked.
videos.hook: Tap. Tap. Tap. Rescuers were knocking on the hull of a capsized ship. And something knocked back.

videos.title: The Moon Freed the Ship That Blocked the Suez Canal.
videos.hook: How do you move a ship that weighs over two hundred thousand tonnes, when she is stuck in sand?

videos.title: How Did a Cook Survive Inside a Sunken Tugboat?
videos.hook: A diver searched a sunken tug, expecting no survivors. Then, in the dark, a hand moved.
